name: IC Analog Audio — I2C — TSSOP
description: Analog audio IC cluster for I2C-controlled surface-mount devices in TSSOP packages such as TSSOP-28-1EP.
selection_hints: Designing for analog audio IC applications requiring an I2C control interface.
Using surface-mount TSSOP footprints such as TSSOP-28-1EP with thermal vias.
Selecting tier B parts like TAS5805MPWP from KiCad symbol libraries.
avoid_when: The design requires non-TSSOP package types or through-hole mounting.
An audio IC without an I2C control interface is required.
The layout cannot accommodate the TSSOP-28-1EP thermal pad footprint.
